title: ADHD vs Non ADHD: 3 Relatable ADHD Loops (Funny Animation Compilation)
description:
Be honest... which ADHD loop is YOU? Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇

00:00 ADHD Loops Vol. 1
00:03 Loop 1: Getting ONE thing (the doorway effect)
00:48 Loop 2: A hot cup of coffee (ADHD time blindness)
01:31 Loop 3: A glass of water
02:26 Which loop is you?

Skip is thirsty, his coffee is getting cold, and his phone is on 1%. Three everyday ADHD loops, animated:
• The doorway effect: walking through a door can wipe out what you were doing, and with ADHD it hits even harder. Tip: say it out loud the whole way there.
• ADHD time blindness: when a task is boring, the ADHD brain goes hunting for something more interesting and time disappears. Tip: set a timer you can HEAR.
• The thirsty loop: one task turns into five. Tip: say the task out loud until it's done.

These are relatable comedy skits, not medical advice. Tag the friend who needs to see this.
